description: Labels describe the requested workflow, not past behavior. Orientation is true for a repository tour, purpose/layout overview, or an overview of a named implementation area; investigations of how mechanisms relate or work, including comparisons across independent areas, one-file/symbol/fact questions, capability listings, session facts, edits, greetings and thanks are negative. Direction is true for undecided third/fourth follow-ups to a generic assistant menu; no specific task is implied by those messages, so their intent is unknown. Intent uses the shared harness-routing criteria: workspace/capability evidence is inspect, supplied session facts or conversation are answer, a requested edit is implement. Breadth is repository for whole-project orientation, area for named areas, focused for a specific file/symbol/fact, and omitted when inapplicable. All eighteen S3 scenario cases contribute their probe text, with each undecided scenario contributing both its third and fourth turns (21 cases); four verbatim orientation-shaped dispatch-recipe turns and four turn-sites controls bring the total to 29.
